population_note: Every figure is computed on the items every judge answered in every arm, fixed once before any estimator is scored.

five_vs_two_coordinates.note: The comparison a five-field checklist has to win is against the best two-coordinate estimator, not against a five-coordinate rule with two of its inputs deleted.

degenerate_arm.reading: On this arm the reference verdict never varies, so the constant predictor scores 1.00 and no estimator can beat it. It is reported to show that judges do not answer 'undefined' whenever a coordinate is missing, which is a check on the judges, not evidence that the schema is codable under withholding.
